PROJECT NOTES

Behind Parallax.

Place a portal on the observatory, pause the orbit, then break the frame to inspect the two pixels that put the portal there. In the Impossible Room, discover how two different worlds can produce the same footage.

Watch the experiment

View source on GitHub

Implementation and AI use

Codex generated the JavaScript, procedural scene and demo. The running site uses Canvas 2D and the browser’s video decoder. Its corner detection, tracking, pose estimation and triangulation are implemented in the repository.
